interest: Shows 1935 ONI-State coordination on intelligence suggesting Japan could become a major arms producer, with a claim concerning Brazil.
overview: Dec 1935 letters: Capt. Puleston sends Hornbeck a German-sourced report on Japan's arms-production potential, including a Brazil claim ONI is verifying; Hornbeck returns it and asks to be kept informed.

people.name: William D. Puleston
people.role: Captain, U.S. Navy; Director of Naval Intelligence

people.name: Stanley K. Hornbeck
people.role: Chief, Division of Far Eastern Affairs, Department of State

subfiles.about: Transmission of a confidential intelligence report received via Germany regarding Japan's potential to become a major producer and exporter of armaments.
subfiles.from: Captain W. D. Puleston, Director of Naval Intelligence
subfiles.summary: Puleston sends Hornbeck a German-sourced report on Japan's arms-production potential, noting ONI is verifying a Brazil-related claim.
subfiles.title: Letter from Captain W. D. Puleston to Dr. Stanley K. Hornbeck transmitting report on Japanese armament production
subfiles.to: Dr. Stanley K. Hornbeck, Division of Far Eastern Affairs, Department of State

subfiles.about: Acknowledgment and return of the intelligence report on Japanese armament production, with a request for updates on ONI's findings.
subfiles.from: Dr. Stanley K. Hornbeck, Chief, Division of Far Eastern Affairs
subfiles.summary: Hornbeck returns Puleston's report on Japanese armament production, asking to be told of any ONI findings.
subfiles.title: Letter from Dr. Stanley K. Hornbeck to Captain W. D. Puleston acknowledging and returning report
subfiles.to: Captain W. D. Puleston, Director of Naval Intelligence
